parameters.content:
## About this workflow
**Prerequisites**
- An **Administrate OAuth2** credential (see the Credentials note)
- Optional: a DMS folder for import files (`dmsFolderName` in **Config**, reference only)

**How to use it**
Create a spreadsheet (.xlsx) whose first row holds these headers (names are set in **Config**):
- Account Name
- email
- First Name
- Last Name

Attach the file to the Event (Documents section on the Outline tab), then run **Import Learners from Spreadsheet** from the Event's Automator menu.

## What it does
The workflow takes the data from the Excel file, and looks at each entry:
It will search for existing contacts by their email address. If there is an existing contact with this email address, it will use them. If an existing Contact in the Excel file is already registered on the Event, it will not attempt to add them again.
If the existing Contact is not already on the Event, it will register them on to it.

If there are no existing Contacts with the email address provided, the workflow will search for the Account Name provided:
If the Account is not found, the contact will not be created
If the Account is an Individual Account, the contact will not be created
If the Account name is found, a new Contact will be created under it.
It will then register this new Contact on to the Event.

All above scenarios record a message for each Contact in the Excel file. These will then be added to the Event's internal notes to give a summary of what contacts have been added/not added/created/not created, and why.

Names and values containing quotes or apostrophes are sent as GraphQL variables, so they can't break the queries.

parameters.content:
## Config Explained
Every value that might need changing lives in the **Config** node below. Edit it there once; everything downstream reads from it.

**apiUrl** — The Administrate GraphQL endpoint every API call uses. The default public endpoint works for every instance; the OAuth2 credential decides which instance is used.

**allowedFileExtensions** — Comma-separated file types the workflow will treat as the import spreadsheet (default `xlsx,xls`). Widen only if you start uploading other formats.

**documentNameFirstChoice / documentNameSecondChoice** — If an Event has several attached files, the workflow picks the one whose name contains the first choice (`attendees`), then the second (`import`), then falls back to the first spreadsheet found. Change these to match how you name your upload.

**colEmail / colFirstName / colLastName / colAccountName** — The exact column header names in your Excel file. Update these if your spreadsheet uses different headers.

**dmsFolderName** — The DMS folder learners' files live in (default `Student Import Files`). Reference only — used in the instructions, not enforced by logic.

**Credentials** — Not in Config. Select the Administrate OAuth2 credential on each Administrate node after importing.
